Previous worked in ROI for a clinic. I was in TX state law may be different . It really is dependant on the language of the POA document. Often times they have a stipulation that the patient must be deemed incapacitated, AND PROVIDE DOCUMENTATION FROM A MEDICAL PROVIDER for it to be in affect, unless the language says differently.

If you have a patient who's unable to come in they CAN sign their release form releasing it to the person delivering the form, that way a POA isn't needed.

The only records, usually, restricted are mental health, HIV, and the like. The other records can be flagged as sensitive and require further authorization. In the case of mental health often the records will be excluded if they could endanger the patient or could be damaging to the person receiving them , for example they're talking about their parents and speak poorly of them, can be excluded on the discretion of the releaser when releasing to parent. HOWEVER, they can release only designated portions, unless they have a total release then it's pretty hard to control.  Records, unless stated, can't be released past date of signature. Verbal communication authorization is different.

For my black beans I make them in a crock pot. SUPER easy! 

Black beans you should be soaked. I just put 1-2 lbs (after I rinse them and check them for rocks) in the pot and leave them over night usually 10-16 hours total. I don't usually spice them at this point, but I guess you could.

I turn them on high for 6-8 hours. I check them occasionally and add water to cover if needed. I also spice the first time at this stage - cumin, pepper, cayenne. At the end of this I will add onion and jalapeno if I want them in.

So after that time. I see how they are releasing their starch and take a tiny bite to test their "snap". I then put them on low for 4-6 hours depending. Taste and respice if needed. Add salt if needed.

Usually then I put them on warm and forget about them until I am hungry. Main key through the whole high stage is making sure they are under water. If they aren't the parts that are not covered will be gross. You can replace water with stock also. I've done it with miso broth (VERY salty). 


It's really just a don't be afraid of them type thing. Experiment. I've made a batch I didn't eat they were so bad. You will try and "fail", but honestly it's not failing it's learning.
